announcement.quote: Franklin BSP Capital Corp. and Franklin BSP Lending Corp. Announce Merger Agreement

outcome_evidence.quote: today announced the completion of their previously announced merger. FBCC is the surviving company in the merger

deals.notes: Both are described as business development companies, but no excerpt shows an exchange listing or ticker for either, so both_listed is null. The N-14 8C filings of 2025-01-14 onward in this window concern an exchange offer for 7.200% Notes, not a fund merger.
